verses.text: On the fifth day of the sixth month, in the sixth year, I was sitting in my house with the elders of Judah sitting in front of me. There the power of the Lord GOD came on me.
I looked, and I saw a figure that looked like a man. From his waist down he looked like fire, and from his waist up he was bright, like glowing metal.

He reached out what looked like a hand and took me by the hair of my head. The Spirit lifted me up between earth and sky, and in visions from God he brought me to Jerusalem. He took me to the entrance of the north gate of the inner courtyard, where the idol that makes God jealous stood.
And there was the glory of the God of Israel, just as I had seen it in the vision on the plain.
Then he said to me, "Son of man, look toward the north." So I looked toward the north, and there in the entrance, north of the altar gate, was this idol that makes God jealous.

He said to me, "Son of man, do you see what they are doing? Do you see the terrible, disgusting things the people of Israel are doing here, things that will drive me far from my holy place? But you will see things even more disgusting than these."
Then he brought me to the entrance of the courtyard. I looked, and I saw a hole in the wall.
He said to me, "Son of man, dig into the wall." So I dug into the wall and found a doorway.
He said to me, "Go in and see the wicked, disgusting things they are doing here."
So I went in and looked. All over the walls were drawings of all kinds of crawling creatures and unclean animals, and all the idols of the people of Israel.

Seventy elders of Israel were standing in front of them, with Jaazaniah son of Shaphan standing among them. Each of them had an incense burner in his hand, and a sweet-smelling cloud of incense was rising.
He said to me, "Son of man, have you seen what the elders of Israel are doing in the dark, each at the shrine of his own idol? They say, 'The LORD does not see us. The LORD has abandoned the land.'"
Then he said to me, "You will see them doing things even more disgusting than these."
Then he brought me to the entrance of the north gate of the LORD's temple, and I saw women sitting there, weeping for the god Tammuz.
He said to me, "Do you see this, son of man? You will see things even more disgusting than these."

Then he brought me into the inner courtyard of the LORD's temple. There at the entrance of the temple, between the porch and the altar, were about twenty-five men. Their backs were turned to the LORD's temple, and they faced east. They were bowing down to the sun in the east.

He said to me, "Do you see this, son of man? Is it not enough for the people of Judah to do the disgusting things they are doing here? They also fill the land with violence and keep making me angry. Look at them insulting me by holding a branch to their nose!
So I will deal with them in my fury. I will not look on them with pity or spare them. Even if they shout in my ears, I will not listen to them."
